data.name: Anisah
data.gender_notes: Anisah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anisah is a beautiful Arabic name meaning 'friendly' or 'close companion'. It reflects warmth, kindness, and a sociable nature. Girls named Anisah are often seen as compassionate and approachable, embodying the essence of friendship and harmony. The name Anisah carries the meaning “Friendly, Companion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, English. Parents who choose Anisah usually hope their child will grow to embody friendly, companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Anisah symbolizes a soul that radiates love, unity, and divine companionship. It encourages building strong bonds and nurturing relationships.
data.etymology: Anisah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friendly, Companion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anisah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: أنيسة
in_arabic.long_meaning: الحُبّ الغَرِيبُ، الفَتنَةُ المُتَفانَةُ، المُنِيَرَةُ البُهَيِرَةُ، المُحِبَّةُ المُلتَفِئةُ، المُنىُ المُتَفانِيَةُ. يَنْصُدُ الحُبُّ الغَرِيبُ الإِنسانَ، فَيَستَغيثُ بِالرُبى. يَكونُ الحُبُّ غَيرَ مُتَبَدِّلٍ مِنَ النَفْسِ، لِأَنَّهُ يَكونُ مِنَ النَفْسِ، وَيَكونُ مِنَ اللَهِ. يَنِعَمُ الحُبُّ الغَرِيبُ الإِنسانَ بِالتَعَلُّمِ، وَالإِقتِناسِ، وَالإِخلاصِ.

in_urdu.name: انیسہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: غریبی محبت انسان کو ایک ایسے عالم میں ڈال دیتی ہے جہاں ہر گھڑی ایک نئی چیلنج کی شکل میں آتی ہے۔ محبت کا جذبہ انسان کے دل کو بھر دیتا ہے اور اسے اپنے آپ کو ایک نئی دنیا میں لے جاتا ہے۔ محبت ایک ایسا جاذب ہے جو دنیا کی تمام سستیوں کو اپنے درپے کر دیتا ہے اور انسان کے دل کو ایک ایسے محنت کی زینت سے آراستہ کر دیتا ہے جس سے انسان اپنے آپ کو ایک نئے انسان بناتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अनीसा
in_hindi.long_meaning: अनोखी प्रेम मनुष्य को एक ऐसे विश्व में डालती है जहाँ हर घंटी एक नई चुनौती के रूप में आती है। प्रेम का भाव मनुष्य के हृदय को भर देता है और उसे एक नई दुनिया ले जाता है। प्रेम एक ऐसा आकर्षक है जो दुनिया की सभी सुस्तियों को अपने पीछे छोड़ देता है और मनुष्य के हृदय को एक ऐसी मेहनत की सजावट से सजाता है जिससे मनुष्य एक नए मनुष्य को जन्म देता है।

in_pashto.name: انيسه

in_english.name: Anisah
in_english.long_meaning: The love-struck is a state of being that is beyond human control, a frenzy of emotions that can be both exhilarating and devastating. In Islamic tradition, love is seen as a divine gift, a blessing that brings joy and light into one's life. The Arabic root of the name, "anisa," means "stranger" or "beloved," and the long form of the name, "Anisa al-Hubb," means "the beloved of the heart." The name Anisah is often associated with qualities such as passion, dedication, and loyalty, and is considered a popular choice for girls in many Muslim cultures.

data.cultural_impact: Anisah represents a value cherished in many cultures - companionship and friendship. It is a name that encourages the nurturing of deep and meaningful relationships, especially in communities where collectivism is a way of life. The friendly nature of the name even extends to the broader sense of community, embodying the spirit of sisterhood and camaraderie.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the name Anisah reflects the deep spiritual bond shared between believers and their Creator. The Qur'an (11:114) describes believers as "those to whom We have granted the Faculties of hearing, seeing, and of details" - a reminder that as close companions to their Creator, they are granted the knowledge and understanding to live in accordance with divine guidance. The name Anisah also hints at the uniqueness of this relationship, likening it to a close and nurturing friendship. It is a reminder that through this spiritual bond, believers are supported, guided, and ultimately drawn nearer to their divine companion - Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Anisah is an Islamic name derived from the Arabic word "anis," meaning solace, comfort, or a consoler. A woman named Anisah is thus one who brings peace, tranquility, and comfort to those around her, reflecting the Prophet Muhammad's description of women as the source of comfort and support for their families.
